def two_eyes(fr):
    lines = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    L=[]; R=[]
    for r in range(64):
        for c in range(64):
            if lines[r][c]=='S':
                (L if c<32 else R).append((r,c))
    def box(p):
        rs=[x[0] for x in p]; cs=[x[1] for x in p]
        return (min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
    return box(L), box(R)
for i in range(20,30):
    print(i, history[i].action, 'lv',history[i].frame.level, two_eyes(history[i].frame))
# what did the board look like at idx 25 (last level1 frame) vs 26
b=history[25].frame.ascii.split('\n'); a=history[26].frame.ascii.split('\n')
print('level1 last frame rows 40-56 cols 0-64 sample:')
for r in range(40,56):
    print(r, b[r])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
